title: Evaluating the Bias in LLMs for Surveying Opinion and Decision Making in Healthcare

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with gender-specific personas (Male/Female) to simulate COVID-19 vaccination decisions and measuring disparities across groups using Disparate Impact Ratio (DIR) and Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD).

Injecting racial identities (White, Black, Asian) into persona prompts to generate vaccination decisions, analyzing behavioral variations via DIR and JSD, and comparing the model outputs to real-world survey data.
Evaluating LLM-generated health decisions by varying household income levels in prompts and assessing statistical divergence and disparate impact against human survey baselines.
Assigning different educational attainment levels to prompted personas and measuring the inconsistencies and disparate impact in simulated vaccine acceptance rates.
